Our scout wiremen tapped into the Italian military telegraph copper wire strung
between Sauria forward headquarters and the coastal garrison at Massawa.

- Target File: intercept.pcap
- Target Relay Port: TCP 1896 (Italian Military Telegraph Protocol / IMTP/1.0)
